cd /workspace && timeout 180 python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,time,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
rng=random.Random(1)
fields=[{'name':f'f{i}','type':'flag','domain':[0,1]} for i in range(4)]
K=4;nf=4
preds=[{'kind':'any','field':f'f{i%4}','op':'eq','value':2} for i in range(32)]
flat_domains=[f['domain'] for s in range(K) for f in fields]
train=[]
for _ in range(10000):
 flat=[rng.choice(d) for d in flat_domains]
 train.append([flat[s*nf:(s+1)*nf] for s in range(K)])
queries=[]
for _ in range(64):
 target=[rng.randrange(K),f'f{rng.randrange(4)}']
 fixed=[{'ref':[rng.randrange(K),f'f{rng.randrange(4)}'],'value':rng.randrange(2)} for _ in range(10)]
 # ensure distinct? protocol, but perf only
 fixed=list({tuple(b['ref']):b for b in fixed}.values())
 queries.append({'fixed':fixed,'target':target,'prefix':''})
job={'fields':fields,'slots':K,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':[],'queries':queries}
st=time.time();r=compile_job(job);print('time',time.time()-st,'rules',len(r['rules']))
